$comment: Pacenotes' CI contract (scripts/affected.mjs, .gitea/actions/app-gates, ADR 0014 §6; the field list is in .gitea/actions/README.md): a leg of ci.yml on Linux for its Cargo workspace (fmt, clippy, nextest, doc tests, deny). Stage 1 of the first-release plan holds pure crates only (no Tauri, no UI), so there is no ui, e2e or host leg yet; they come with the app skeleton (stage 2, D0). The checks are the cargo-metadata guard (ADR 0022 §3.7; see apps/pacenotes/scripts/check-no-cargo-metadata.mjs: the real guard is `cargo tree -e features`, conformance C52 is the backstop that reads the manifests) and their tests. The coverage gate (99% lines of product code) runs on main and the nightly only: the gates' nextest already runs every test on a branch, and a second run under llvm-cov would run them twice (rule 50). pacenotes-parse, pacenotes-index, pacenotes-worker, pacenotes-engine and pacenotes-rules are each gated at 95% lines on their own run (one `cargo llvm-cov` per crate, so a pooled total cannot hide a weak file or crate; measured 97.0 (parse), 97.0 (index), 97.0 (worker), 95.7 (engine) and 96.3 (rules)), not 99%. The worker's `pacenotes-worker/src/bin/` (one `main`) and `pacenotes-worker/src/hooks.rs` (the test hooks that abort, exit, spin or block the process they run in) are left out of the gate, and the test workers' own coverage profiles go to /dev/null (`LLVM_PROFILE_FILE` in the tests' worker settings): a worker the host ends leaves a torn profile that fails `cargo llvm-cov` with "no profile can be merged"; the worker's logic is covered in-process by the unit tests of `serve.rs`. What no test reaches: the ABI refusal, `set_language` failure and `NoTree` in parse (no grammar outside the runtime's range exists; the parser returns no tree only when stopped); `?` early returns on a tree-sitter node that lacks a field its table names (the tables test fails first); and, in index, every `map_err(db)?` / `map_err(read_error)?` arm that only fires when SQLite itself fails (disk full, I/O error), the file-system error arms of `DiskFs`, and the failure arms of assert macros in tests.
rustChecks: if [ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = main ] || [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = schedule ]; then cargo llvm-cov nextest -p pacenotes-core -p pacenotes-function-api -p pacenotes-git --profile ci --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'contract\.rs|wire_tests\.rs' --fail-under-lines 99; cargo llvm-cov nextest -p pacenotes-parse --profile ci --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'contract\.rs|wire_tests\.rs|pacenotes-worker/src/bin/|pacenotes-worker/src/hooks\.rs' --fail-under-lines 95; cargo llvm-cov nextest -p pacenotes-index --profile ci --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'contract\.rs|wire_tests\.rs|pacenotes-worker/src/bin/|pacenotes-worker/src/hooks\.rs' --fail-under-lines 95; cargo llvm-cov nextest -p pacenotes-worker --profile ci --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'contract\.rs|wire_tests\.rs|pacenotes-worker/src/bin/|pacenotes-worker/src/hooks\.rs' --fail-under-lines 95; cargo llvm-cov nextest -p pacenotes-engine --profile ci --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'contract\.rs|wire_tests\.rs|pacenotes-worker/src/bin/|pacenotes-worker/src/hooks\.rs' --fail-under-lines 95; cargo llvm-cov nextest -p pacenotes-rules --profile ci --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'contract\.rs|wire_tests\.rs|pacenotes-worker/src/bin/|pacenotes-worker/src/hooks\.rs' --fail-under-lines 95; cargo llvm-cov nextest -p pacenotes-xml --profile ci --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'contract\.rs|wire_tests\.rs|pacenotes-worker/src/bin/|pacenotes-worker/src/hooks\.rs' --fail-under-lines 95; else echo 'coverage gate runs on main and the nightly, not on branches (rule 50); the leg already ran every test'; fi
